items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: He was around New York. He was a cartoonist, you know. I think he did sketches or things for Esquire for a while, and I hadn't heard anything about him for years either.

ctx.x: So I don't even know how Roger Dodge made his living in those late years, not all he did.
How about E. Sims Campbell? Do you know anything about E. Sims Campbell? He wrote the chapter on blues. I've seen him once. I never did really know him.
He was around New York. He was a cartoonist, you know. I think he did sketches or things for Esquire for a while, and I hadn't heard anything about him for years either.
